rci1_using_msad.detail: ABIDE (I and II) is a multi-site aggregated dataset; the supplementary explicitly refers to 'multi-center neuroimaging data analysis'
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "T1-weighted magnetic resonance imaging data from the Autism Brain Imaging Database Exchange (ABIDE)" ; "Site effect is generally an important problem for multi-center neuroimaging data analysis."

rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "The study analyzed both structural neuroimaging data and phenotypic data provided by the Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange (ABIDE) (Di Martino et al., 2017; Di Martino et al., 2014)."
